name: pqmf-exam-guard
description: Guards PQMF exam workspaces by detecting files opened outside the workspace.

pqmfExamGuard.enabled.description: Detect files opened outside the current PQMF exam workspace.

pqmfExamGuard.disableOutOfFocusCheck.description: Disable the VS Code out-of-focus violation check while the exam workspace is active.

pqmfExamGuard.disableOutsideWorkspaceChe.description: Disable violations when files outside the exam workspace are opened.
